admin.loginLead: Log in with the organizer email and password.

qcm.title: Induction quiz
qcm.lead: Open the session here, then watch each candidate on video: current question, last answer, final mark.
qcm.question: Question
qcm.needQuestions: Add questions first, then open the session.
qcm.editorLead: Title, pass mark, then the questions. Tick the correct answer. You can edit while the session is closed.
qcm.locked: The session is open, or a candidate is still taking it. Close it before editing questions.
qcm.passTooHigh: The pass mark cannot be higher than the number of questions.
qcm.cameraWait: Allow the camera and microphone so candidates can see you.
qcm.cameraDenied: Camera or microphone was blocked. Candidates will not see or hear you.
qcm.callEnded: Call ended. Restart it to see candidates again.
qcm.scoresSent: Scores emailed. Candidate screens are now off.
qcm.noScores: There are no candidate scores to send.

errors.apiDown: The API is not reachable. Restart the backend server, then try again.
errors.invalidForm: Check the title, the prompts, and at least two answers per question.
